Prescott Area Association of Realtors (PAAR) publishes monthly updates showing the status of the May home sales through the main areas served in Yavapai County, including Prescott Valley, Prescott, Chino Valley, and Dewey-Humboldt.
Here is a summary of the home sales market statistics in the Quad Cities of central Arizona:
For all of PAAR in May 2026:
- Total Sales: 360
- New Listings: 617
- Active Inventory: 1,559
- Months of Inventory: 4.7
- Median Sold Price: $475,259
- Median Days on Market: 38
Prescott in May 2026:
- Total Sales: 142
- New Listings: 254
- Active Inventory: 663
- Months of Inventory: 4.9
- Median Sold Price: $680,000
- Median Days on Market: 28
Prescott Valley in May 2026:
- Total Sales: 105
- New Listings: 176
- Active Inventory: 351
- Months of Inventory: 3.8
- Median Sold Price: $464,000
- Median Days on Market: 34
Chino Valley in May 2026:
- Total Sales: 31
- New Listings: 39
- Active Inventory: 116
- Months of Inventory: 3.6
- Median Sold Price: $435,000
- Median Days on Market: 44
Dewey-Humboldt in May 2026:
- Total Sales: 26
- New Listings: 42
- Active Inventory: 111
- Months of Inventory: 4.6
- Median Sold Price: $413,950
- Median Days on Market: 60
Review the PAAR Statistics Breakdown for Prescott & Surrounding Areas – May 2026.
Editor’s Note: All data is compiled from the Multiple Listing Service of the Prescott Area Association of REALTORS® and includes single-family, manufactured, mobile, modular, condominiums, and townhouse residential activity in Prescott, Prescott Valley, Chino Valley, and Dewey-Humboldt
